REPORT
Date May 29, 19 36

Subject Execution of Warrant No. 9790 issued at the request of the
Public Safety Bureau.
Made by D.P.S. Henchman. Forwarded by L J J [签名]

At 12.50 a.m. on 24th May 1936 a party of Municipal
Police in conjunction with the Public Safety Bureau visited
house No. 74, Mai Ding Faung, Wuhu Road, the address designated
in the warrant. It was found that the room over the kitchen
was vacant but was stocked with a large quantity of communistic
literature. A watch was kept on the room to see that no
person entered but at 10 a.m. on 24th May, it having been
ascertained that no person had attempted to enter the room,
the literature, about 2 tons in all, was removed to Louza
Station. Enquiries in the vicinity failed to reveal to
whom the literature or the room belonged. The literature
on examination proved to be communist propaganda.

[左侧边缘手写批注/签名]

D Henchman
D. P. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

1936年5月24日凌晨12时50分，一队工部局警察会同公共安全局人员，前往搜查令指定的地址——威海路（Weihai Road）麦定坊（Mai Ding Faung，音译）74号。发现厨房上方的房间空置，但堆存大量共产主义文献。对该房间进行监视，以防有人进入。至5月24日上午10时，经查实无人试图进入该房间后，将总计约2吨的文献运往老闸捕房。在周边进行的查询未能查明这些文献或房间归属何人。经检查，这些文献被证实为共产主义宣传品。

[左侧边缘手写批注/签名]

D Henchman
副巡长

特别处主管警官。

EXECUTION OF SEARCH WARRANT NO.9790.

At 12.30.a.m. on the 24-5-36, D.S.I. Coyne, in
company with Supt. Yang Yeh Ling (楊業林) attached to the
Shanghai Public Safety Bureau, came to this Station with
a Search Warrant, as under.

    Search Warrant No.9790, issued by Judge Daley
    at the request of the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau.
    Address:- Room above the kitchen of House No.74,
              Hai Ning Fung, Weihai Road, off Fokien Road.

    To search for and seize certain communistic litera-
    ture on the above mentioned premises. This warrant
    may be executed at night in accordance with Article
    146 Section 1 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

    The undersigned and C.D.S.164 rendered the
necessary assistance, and upon proceeding to the
disclosed address, found the room vacant, but stocked
with a large quantity of literature, which upon
examination, was stated to be of communistic nature.

    Due to the lateness of the raid, detectives were
placed in the room, pending fuller examination.

    At 10.a.m. on the 24-5-36, it was ascertained
that 2 persons had attempted to enter the room in which
the literature was placed, and all books found on the
premises, amounting to about 3 tons, were brought to
Station for safe custody.

    Residents ceased living at this address.

1936年5月24日凌晨12时30分，副巡长 Coyne 陪同隶属于上海公共安全局的杨业林（Yang Yeh Ling）督察，携带如下搜查令来到本捕房：

    第9790号搜查令，由 Daley 法官应上海公共安全局请求签发。
    地址：福建路（Fokien Road）旁威海路海宁坊（Hai Ning Fung，音译）74号厨房上方的房间。

    在上述处所搜查并扣押某些共产主义文献。根据《刑事诉讼法》第146条第1款之规定，本搜查令可在夜间执行。

    签署人及刑事侦缉警士 164号提供了必要协助，前往上述地址后，发现房间空置，但堆存大量文献，经检查，据称具有共产主义性质。

    由于突击搜查时间较晚，侦探被部署在房间内，以待进一步详细检查。

    1936年5月24日上午10时，经查实有2人试图进入存放文献的房间，现场发现的所有书籍，总计约3吨，被带至捕房妥善保管。

    居民已不再居住于此地址。

（左侧手写批注：）
16 5月25日
Joh.
